title: MotionLabSeries
description: A series groups several projects. kind 'sequential' is an ordered run (part 1, part 2, ...); kind 'collection' clubs related projects with no order. Instance file: series/<slug>/series.json. The series owns membership; projects do not point back. Validate with `scripts/studio.py series validate`.

description.description: What ties the projects together: the arc across parts, or the shared theme.

categories.description: Subject categories (ids from specs/categories.json). Same rules as brief.json.

style.description: Optional shared style id so the members look like one family. Members using another style get a warning.

project.description: Project reference as accepted by studio.py: a slug, a folder name or projects/-relative path such as masala-chai/v3-chemistry-v2.

part.description: Position in a sequential series (required there, not allowed in a collection).

title.description: Part title, if different from the project title.

status.description: planned members need no project folder yet. Default: in-production.
